hazards.evidence: Multiple medication/antiseptic bottles (orange prescription-style vials, a large orange povidone-iodine/Betadine-type bottle, antifungal bottle) left out on the vanity within easy reach.
Razor/shaving items (shaving gel can and an orange-handled razor lying by the basin) together with medication bottles out on the sink.
White raised toilet seat and white safety frame on a white toilet against a light tile floor—low contrast that is easy to misperceive.
